chomagerie.config.shulker_refill.show_me: Displays a message when an item is refilled from a shulker box
chomagerie.config.shulker_refill.enabled: Enables or disables the automatic refill system from shulker boxes
chomagerie.config.shulker_refill.play_so: Plays a sound when an item is refilled from a shulker box
chomagerie.config.shulker_refill.filter_: Only uses shulker boxes with one of the configured names for refill
chomagerie.config.shulker_refill.shulker: Only shulker boxes with one of these exact names will be used for refill
chomagerie.config.team_tag.enabled.comme: Displays your tag before your name using Minecraft scoreboard teams
chomagerie.config.team_tag.tag.comment: Use Minecraft color codes with &: &2Mal&6o. Maximum 16 visible characters, color codes not counted.
chomagerie.config.team_tag.color_mode.co: Manual keeps the codes you type. Selected color applies one Minecraft color to the whole tag. Gradient blends between two hex colors. Rainbow applies a different color to each character.
chomagerie.config.team_tag.minecraft_col: Used when Color Mode is set to Selected color.
chomagerie.config.team_tag.gradient_colo: Used when Color Mode is set to Gradient. Add at least two hex colors, for example #977272 and #E32B2B. More colors create multiple gradient stops.
chomagerie.config.team_tag.gradient_star: Legacy value kept for config migration.
Legacy value kept for config migration.
